chapter: Growing up in the Brubeck family
title: Parents as role models, the 'wapper dapper' and Grandma Myrtle's spanking
summary: The brothers discuss respect for their parents, the mythical belt, a spanking from Grandma Myrtle during the 1958 tour, and little sibling rivalry.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: That’s the kind of stuff you know where you have Dave and Iola for parents you end up thinking about.

Yeah. That’s what I was trying to — I couldn’t fashion a question because to outside observers they both seem like incredible role models. I don’t know if their children think of their parents as role models?
Yeah we do. I mean all of us have deep respect for our parents and all of us have deep respect for the luck we have of being born into this family you know?
Now my wife and I were blessed with two daughters who hardly ever gave us many problems but we did have a time out chair. And I wonder if you had —
Did it have the famous artwork on it?
It wasn’t that fancy. Was there a disciplinary modus operandi with your parents?
When we were little kids there was an infamous mythological belt called the “wapper dapper” —
That we never saw but we heard about it.

Yeah. If you get out of line, you know, “I’m going to have to take out the “wapper dapper” which was — as far as we could figure it was like a big-ass cowboy belt, that maybe had some of those little silver dollar buffalo things left in them so it would hurt extra hard. But and certainly our Grandma Myrtle — I still remember back, this relates directly. When they were gone a long time on that tour in ’58 Grandma Myrtle as the name might imply was a tall, just completely straight ahead kind of person, like the famous painting that you see on the Corn Flakes box. She would make that lady look like a complete roaring 20s floozy. She was just a stiff straight ahead person. And so I did something wrong and she, being of a previous generation, said, “I’m going to give you a spanking.” And I can’t even remember what I did wrong. But I remember like I’m always the clever one, I put a Dr. Suess book in the back of my pants so when she spanked me it wouldn’t hurt as much. And of course she never noticed. The book was removed and I got double the spanking. Because she stayed with us for a couple of months while Mom and Darius and Michael were with Dave on that famous Middle Eastern tour.
Was there sibling rivalry on and off? I guess musically is my question but maybe with other things?
I don’t think so so much. We were mainly harmoniously playing together at different things. And sometimes we’d temporarily pull in the same direction and then pull in different directions.
